//: React Router owns the URLs, but Vercel serves files. A visitor who lands
on /signin directly, or reloads it, asks the server for a file that does
not exist and gets a 404 — even though the route works fine once the app
is running. This hands every unmatched path to index.html so the router
can resolve it in the browser.
Static assets are unaffected: Vercel checks the filesystem first and only
applies rewrites to paths that matched no file.
